sloka: तीक्ष्णम् अल्प प्रदातारम् प्रमत्तम् गर्वितम् शठम् ।व्यसने सर्व भूतानि न अभिधावन्ति पार्थिवम् ॥३-३३-१५॥
transliteration: tīkṣṇam alpa pradātāram pramattam garvitam śaṭham ।vyasane sarva bhūtāni na abhidhāvanti pārthivam ॥3-33-15॥

translations.english: All living beings stop seeking refuge under a king who is, not a generous giver, but intoxicated, harsh, arrogant and fraudulent. They do not run to him for protection in times of calamity.
